banks.title: Grammar GT: tense, artikel, modal, dan kalimat kondisional

questions.prompt: My brother ___ in a hospital.
questions.explanation_id: Present Simple + he/she/it: kata kerja + s.

questions.prompt: Look! The children ___ in the garden.
questions.explanation_id: 'Look!' = sedang terjadi: Present Continuous.

questions.prompt: I ___ this laptop two years ago.
questions.explanation_id: Waktu lampau spesifik (two years ago): Simple Past.

questions.prompt: She ___ in Medan since 2018.
questions.explanation_id: since + titik waktu: Present Perfect.

questions.prompt: He is ___ honest man.
questions.explanation_id: Honest dimulai bunyi vokal: an.

questions.prompt: She gave me some useful ___.
questions.explanation_id: Information uncountable.

questions.prompt: You ___ park here. It is forbidden.
questions.explanation_id: Mustn't = larangan.

questions.prompt: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home.
questions.explanation_id: First conditional: if + present, will + V1.

questions.prompt: If I ___ you, I would accept the offer.
questions.explanation_id: Second conditional: If I were you.

questions.prompt: The report ___ yesterday.
questions.explanation_id: Pasif simple past: was + V3.

questions.prompt: The woman ___ daughter is a pilot works at the bank.
questions.explanation_id: Whose menyatakan kepemilikan.

questions.prompt: ___ it was raining, we played football.
questions.explanation_id: Although + klausa (kontras).

questions.prompt: Lengkapi: She ___ not like spicy food. (negatif, he/she/it)
questions.explanation_id: Negatif Present Simple: does not + V1.

questions.prompt: Lengkapi dengan V3 dari 'write': She has ___ three essays this week.
questions.explanation_id: Present Perfect: has + V3 (written).

questions.prompt: Lengkapi: I look forward to ___ from you. (hear)
questions.explanation_id: Look forward to + V-ing.

questions.prompt: Lengkapi dengan preposisi: I have lived here ___ three years.
questions.explanation_id: for + durasi.

questions.prompt: Klik kata yang salah.
questions.explanation_id: Setelah did, kata kerja kembali ke bentuk dasar: go.

questions.prompt: Klik kata yang salah.
questions.explanation_id: Surat formal tanpa singkatan dan 'gonna': I am going to.

questions.prompt: Susun menjadi kalimat yang benar.
questions.explanation_id: Pola: Not only + did + subjek + V1, but ... also.

questions.prompt: Cocokkan kalimat dengan tense-nya.
questions.explanation_id: Kebiasaan = Present Simple; waktu lampau spesifik = Simple Past; pengalaman = Present Perfect.

left: I have walked to work many times.

questions.prompt: By the time we arrived at the station, the train ___.
questions.explanation_id: Kejadian yang lebih dulu selesai sebelum kejadian lampau lain: Past Perfect (had + V3).

questions.prompt: Choose TWO sentences that are grammatically correct.
questions.explanation_id: for + durasi (five years), since + titik waktu (2020). Present Perfect dipakai untuk keadaan yang berlanjut sampai sekarang, bukan Present Simple.
options: She has worked here since five years.
She has worked here for five years.
She has been working here since 2020.
correct_answers: She has worked here for five years.
She has been working here since 2020.

questions.prompt: Excuse me, could you tell me the way to ___ nearest post office?
questions.explanation_id: Superlatif (nearest) selalu memakai 'the'.

questions.prompt: Complete with an article: She works as ___ engineer for a large construction company.
questions.explanation_id: Profesi tunggal memakai a/an; 'engineer' diawali bunyi vokal sehingga 'an'.

questions.prompt: If I had known about the delay, I ___ a later train.
questions.explanation_id: Third conditional (pengandaian masa lampau): If + had + V3, would have + V3.

questions.prompt: Complete with the correct form of 'melt': If you heat ice, it ___.
questions.explanation_id: Zero conditional (fakta umum): If + Present Simple, Present Simple. Subjek 'it' -> melts.

questions.prompt: All staff members ___ to wear an ID badge at all times.
questions.explanation_id: Staf adalah pihak yang dikenai aturan, jadi pasif: are required (be + V3).

questions.prompt: Complete with the future passive of 'open' (use 'will'): The new library ___ by the mayor next month.
questions.explanation_id: Pasif future: will be + V3 -> will be opened.

questions.prompt: The flat ___ I rented last year had a beautiful view.
questions.explanation_id: Benda (flat) sebagai objek 'rented': which/that. 'Where' tidak bisa karena 'rented' butuh objek.

questions.prompt: Click the incorrect word.
questions.explanation_id: Untuk orang dipakai 'who' atau 'that', bukan 'which': The man who lives next door.

questions.prompt: You ___ bring your own towel because the gym provides them.
questions.explanation_id: Tidak wajib (tetapi boleh) = don't have to. Mustn't berarti larangan.

questions.prompt: Her car is in the car park and she isn't answering her phone, so she ___ be in the meeting.
questions.explanation_id: Kesimpulan yang sangat yakin berdasarkan bukti: must + V1.

questions.prompt: Neither the manager nor the assistants ___ available on Fridays.
questions.explanation_id: Neither ... nor: kata kerja mengikuti subjek terdekat (the assistants, jamak) -> are.

questions.prompt: Click the incorrect word.
questions.explanation_id: 'Each of + jamak' tetap dianggap tunggal: Each of the rooms has.

questions.prompt: Complete with 'has' or 'have': The number of applicants ___ increased this year.
questions.explanation_id: 'The number of' bersubjek tunggal -> has. (Bandingkan: 'A number of applicants have...').

questions.prompt: I'm considering ___ to a smaller flat.
questions.explanation_id: Consider diikuti gerund (V-ing): considering moving.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct verb form to complete each sentence.
questions.explanation_id: decide/refuse + to-infinitive; enjoy/mind + V-ing.

questions.prompt: This flat is ___ than the one we saw yesterday.
questions.explanation_id: Komparatif kata pendek: adjektiva + -er (bigger); 'much' menguatkan. 'More bigger' salah.

questions.prompt: Complete with the superlative of 'good': It is the ___ hotel in the city.
questions.explanation_id: Superlatif tidak beraturan: good - better - best.

questions.prompt: Put the parts in order to make a correct sentence.
questions.explanation_id: Third conditional pasif: If + had been + V3, would have + V3.
